notes: Posted as the site's own form posts it to ResultsExtract.Asp, with OfficialResults=Y (the site offers official results for this election). Fetched by ballot/a build step; only the date, party code, race code, office, county, jurisdiction numbers, candidate's name and votes are read.

Compiled by the Division from the files each county's supervisor of elections submits within ten business days after the state certifies the election (s. 98.0981(3), Florida Statutes); listed on https://dos.fl.gov/elections/data-statistics/elections-data/precinct-level-election-results/. Columns read: county code, precinct, contest, district, contest code, candidate, party, the Division's candidate number and votes; never the polling place, the registration counts or the candidates' voter registration numbers. Fetched by ballot/a build step.
The page is headed "Official Results". Its contest-wide figures are the control on the county rows.
